pairs.target: ruǎn héng méiyǒu zài jíhé chù děng tǎ wéi .
pairs.english: Ruanheng wasn't waiting for Tavi at the meeting place.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡没有在集合处等塔维。

pairs.target: tā dào le cái fāxiàn , lùbiān nà rén zhèng dūn zài gōukǒu , bànbiān shēnzi bèi shílán dǎng zhe .
pairs.english: Arriving, Tavi found him crouched at the ditch mouth, half hidden by stone railings.
pairs.hanzi: 他到了才发现，路边那人正蹲在沟口，半边身子被石栏挡着。

pairs.target: pángbiān de nǚrén bèi yíkuài xiězìbǎn , jiàn tǎ wéi ná zhe xuéxiào nà lián zhǐ , cháo gōukǒu zhǐ le zhǐ , shuō rén méi zǒu diū , zài xiàmiàn .
pairs.english: A woman carrying a writing board saw Tavi holding his school slip and pointed down: he wasn't lost, just below.
pairs.hanzi: 旁边的女人背一块写字板，见塔维拿着学校那联纸，朝沟口指了指，说人没走丢，在下面。

pairs.target: tā jiào yù hé , shì suǒ lǐ de cèhuìyuán , bù cóng bái jiē chūlái , yǐjīng gēn zhè jǐduàn tōnglù zǒu le sìnián .
pairs.english: Her name was Yuhe, the office surveyor, not from White Steps, four years working these routes.
pairs.hanzi: 她叫郁禾，是所里的测绘员，不从白阶出来，已经跟这几段通路走了四年。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi gāng yào hǎn ruǎn shīfu , gōulǐ xiān chuánlái yíjù , bié zhàn zài tā tóudǐng , ní huì wǎng lǐngkǒu diào .
pairs.english: Just as Tavi went to call Master Ruan, the ditch spoke first: don't stand over his head, dirt would fall into his collar.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维刚要喊阮师傅，沟里先传来一句，别站在他头顶，泥会往领口掉。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi lìkè tuì kāi .
pairs.english: Tavi stepped back immediately.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维立刻退开。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng páshànglái , jiānshàng réng duō le yìxiǎo tuán ní , zìjǐ pāidiào , wèn tā chī guò zǎofàn méiyǒu .
pairs.english: Ruanheng climbed up, brushed mud from his shoulder and asked whether he had eaten breakfast.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡爬上来，肩上仍多了一小团泥，自己拍掉，问他吃过早饭没有。

pairs.target: tīngshuō chī le , biàn jiāng yìgēn liáng gān dìguòqù , shuō xiān gēn yù hé zǒu dào qiáotóu .
pairs.english: Hearing yes, he handed him a measuring rod to take with Yuhe to the bridge.
pairs.hanzi: 听说吃了，便将一根量杆递过去，说先跟郁禾走到桥头。

pairs.target: zhè tiáo jìn chéng tōnglù yìbiān jiē cāng yuàn , yìbiān tōng zhù qū .
pairs.english: This near-city route linked warehouses and homes.
pairs.hanzi: 这条近城通路一边接仓院，一边通住区。

pairs.target: chūqián qǐng tāmen xiān kàn qiáo de cāng xíng yǐ pài rén lái , jiàn ruǎn héng cóng gōulǐ chūlái , liǎnsè bútàihǎo , shuō chēduì děng zhe , zěnme xiānchá zhèbiān .
pairs.english: The warehouse funding the bridge check had sent a man; seeing Ruanheng emerge from the ditch, he complained the carts were waiting, so why check here first?
pairs.hanzi: 出钱请他们先看桥的仓行已派人来，见阮衡从沟里出来，脸色不太好，说车队等着，怎么先查这边。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng shuō zìjǐ láidezǎo , qiáo hái méi dào yuē de shíchén , zhènghǎo kàn yìyǎn gōu .
pairs.english: Ruanheng said he was early, before the bridge appointment, with time to look at the ditch.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡说自己来得早，桥还没到约的时辰，正好看一眼沟。

pairs.target: nánrén wèn shìbushì zhùhù yòu lán tā shuōhuà , tā méiyǒu jiē zhège huàtóu , zhī bǎ gāng liáng de shuǐ hén zhǐ gěi yù hé kàn .
pairs.english: Asked if residents had stopped him again, he didn't take the bait, just showed Yuhe the measured water mark.
pairs.hanzi: 男人问是不是住户又拦他说话，他没有接这个话头，只把刚量的水痕指给郁禾看。

pairs.target: qiáo lí gōukǒu búguò bǎibù .
pairs.english: The bridge was barely a hundred paces away.
pairs.hanzi: 桥离沟口不过百步。

pairs.target: chē hái méi lái , tiāodàn hé bēilǒu de rén què yì bō bō guò .
pairs.english: No carts yet, but people with shoulder loads and baskets kept passing.
pairs.hanzi: 车还没来，挑担和背篓的人却一拨拨过。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yuán xiǎng bǎ liáng gān héng zhe fàngdào dìshàng , hǎo téng shǒu nábǐ , yù hé shēnjiǎo gōuzhù gān wěi , jiào tā shùqǐ lái .
pairs.english: Tavi meant to lay the rod across the ground to free a hand for his pen; Yuhe caught its end with her foot and told him to stand it upright.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维原想把量杆横着放到地上，好腾手拿笔，郁禾伸脚勾住杆尾，叫他竖起来。

pairs.target: " zhèér búshì wǒmen de jiàoshì .
pairs.english: “This isn't our classroom.
pairs.hanzi: “这儿不是我们的教室。

pairs.target: ràng rén xiān zǒu . "
pairs.english: Let people pass first.”
pairs.hanzi: 让人先走。”

pairs.target: tā kào dào lán páng , tì tā fúzhù zhígān , dúchū liǎngchù gāodù .
pairs.english: At the railing he held the vertical rod for her and read two heights.
pairs.hanzi: 他靠到栏旁，替她扶住直杆，读出两处高度。

pairs.target: dìyīcì shēngyīn tài qīng , bèi chēlún gài le , tā méi tīngjiàn , jiào tā zhòng bào .
pairs.english: His first call was drowned by wheels; she couldn't hear and asked him to repeat it.
pairs.hanzi: 第一次声音太轻，被车轮盖了，她没听见，叫他重报。

pairs.target: tā yòu bào yíbiàn , zhèhuí méiyǒu bǎ bú quèdìng de wěishù tūndiào , míngshuō zuìhòu nà yìdiǎn dé chóngxīn kàn .
pairs.english: Repeating, he didn't swallow an uncertain final digit, saying it needed rechecking.
pairs.hanzi: 他又报一遍，这回没有把不确定的尾数吞掉，明说最后那一点得重新看。

pairs.target: yù hé zhuǎnguò lái hé le yícì , zài zhǐ shàng jìxià .
pairs.english: Yuhe checked and recorded it.
pairs.hanzi: 郁禾转过来核了一次，在纸上记下。

pairs.target: tā méi yīnwèi tā shì gēn gǎng xuéshēng jiù bǎ měijù dōu kuā yíbiàn , shōugān shí què fàngxīn ràng tā xiān zǒu , zìjǐ zài hòutou kàn jiǎoxià de shuǐxiàn .
pairs.english: She didn't praise every word because he was a placement student, but trusted him to lead with the rod while she watched the water line behind.
pairs.hanzi: 她没因为他是跟岗学生就把每句都夸一遍，收杆时却放心让他先走，自己在后头看脚下的水线。

pairs.target: qiáo de zhǔliáng méiyǒu xīn yí , lán biān yíkuài diànpiàn sōng le , dé ràng yǎnghù de rén huàn , bùnéng ná zhèdiǎn xiǎomáobìng dāng zhěngzuò qiáo méishì de zhèngjù .
pairs.english: The main beam hadn't shifted anew. A loose shim beside the railing needed maintenance replacement; that small fault couldn't prove the entire bridge sound.
pairs.hanzi: 桥的主梁没有新移，栏边一块垫片松了，得让养护的人换，不能拿这点小毛病当整座桥没事的证据。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng bǎ jiǎnchá fànwéi shuō gěi cāng xíng lái rén tīng , ràng chē àn yuánlái de xiàn zǎi zǒu , lìng yuē kànzhòng chē de lúnjù , bú zài jīntiān zhǐ shàng tì méi lái de chē zuò bǎozhèng .
pairs.english: Ruanheng explained the inspection scope to the warehouse man: original load limits applied, with a separate check for heavy-cart wheel spacing. No guarantees for absent carts today.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡把检查范围说给仓行来人听，让车按原来的限载走，另约看重车的轮距，不在今天纸上替没来的车作保证。

pairs.target: nánrén cuī tā xiān xiě gè néng guò .
pairs.english: The man pressed him to write “passable” first.
pairs.hanzi: 男人催他先写个能过。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng shuō néng xiě , xiàn zǎi yě yìqǐ xiě .
pairs.english: Ruanheng said he could write that, including the load limit too.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡说能写，限载也一起写。

pairs.target: nà rén zhòu zhe méi , zuìhòu shēnshǒu jiēguò le zhǐ .
pairs.english: Frowning, the man accepted the paper.
pairs.hanzi: 那人皱着眉，最后伸手接过了纸。

pairs.target: huídào gōukǒu , wèntí fǎnér bǐ qiáo shàng duō .
pairs.english: Back at the ditch, there were more problems than at the bridge.
pairs.hanzi: 回到沟口，问题反而比桥上多。

pairs.target: chūkǒu wàiyán bèi qiánjǐcì qīng gōu de ní duīgāo , shuǐ búshì quán bù liú , shì liú dào zhèlǐ màn le , shāo dà yìdiǎn biàn tuìhuí zhù qū .
pairs.english: Previous cleanings had piled mud outside the outlet; water still flowed but slowed here, backing toward homes with any increase.
pairs.hanzi: 出口外沿被前几次清沟的泥堆高，水不是全不流，是流到这里慢了，稍大一点便退回住区。

pairs.target: zhùhù yǐwéi zhǐyào bǎ lǐtou tāo shēn , cāng yuàn de rén quèshuō wàimiàn de ní dì bù guī zìjǐ .
pairs.english: Residents thought deepening the ditch would suffice; warehouse people said the mud outside wasn't theirs.
pairs.hanzi: 住户以为只要把里头掏深，仓院的人却说外面的泥地不归自己。

pairs.target: yù hé jiāng yuántú pūkāi , zhǐ gěi ruǎn héng kàn , jiùyuē lǐ nà yì jié qīng zǒu de ní dé yùndào nǎlǐ .
pairs.english: Yuhe opened the original plan, showing Ruanheng where the contract required cleared mud to go.
pairs.hanzi: 郁禾将原图铺开，指给阮衡看，旧约里那一截清走的泥得运到哪里。

pairs.target: búshì tā yíjù tì shuí zuòzhǔ , shì yǐjīng yǒurén lǐng guò zhè yífèn qián , què zhī bǎ ní cóng gōulǐ nuó dào le kǒu wài .
pairs.english: Not an arbitrary ruling: someone had been paid, but only moved mud from ditch to mouth.
pairs.hanzi: 不是他一句替谁做主，是已经有人领过这一份钱，却只把泥从沟里挪到了口外。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi hūrán tīngdǒng le , zhǐ shàng nà yìxiǎo jù , yuánlái néng zài dìshàng duīqǐ zhèyàng yìdǔ shī qiáng .
pairs.english: Tavi suddenly understood how one small sentence on paper could pile up a wet wall on the ground.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维忽然听懂了，纸上那一小句，原来能在地上堆起这样一堵湿墙。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng qù zhǎo yǎnghù lǐngbān shuōhuà , jiào tā hé yù hé liúzài bù dǎnglù de dìfāng zài hé gāochā .
pairs.english: Ruanheng went to the maintenance foreman, leaving Tavi and Yuhe to recheck heights without blocking traffic.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡去找养护领班说话，叫他和郁禾留在不挡路的地方再核高差。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu ràng tǎ wéi xià gōu mō jiù tiě , gèng méi bǎi chū qìjù , bǎ yìchǎng rén zhījiān gāi shuō qīng de huó gǎichéng zìjǐ lù běnshì .
pairs.english: He neither sent Tavi to touch old iron in the ditch nor turned a human responsibility into an apparatus display of his own skill.
pairs.hanzi: 他没有让塔维下沟摸旧铁，更没摆出器具，把一场人之间该说清的活改成自己露本事。

pairs.target: línjìn zhōngwǔ , yǎnghù duì de rén lái le , xiān jiāng kǒu wài de ní chǎn dī , zhuāng shàng xiǎochē .
pairs.english: Near noon the maintenance crew came, shoveling down the mud outside onto little carts.
pairs.hanzi: 临近中午，养护队的人来了，先将口外的泥铲低，装上小车。

pairs.target: shuǐ méiyǒu hōngdeyìshēng chōngzǒu , zhǐshì yánzhe yuánxiān nàtiáo xìlù , mànmàn búzài wǎng shàng màn .
pairs.english: Water didn't rush away with a roar; along its old narrow route it gradually stopped backing up.
pairs.hanzi: 水没有轰的一声冲走，只是沿着原先那条细路，慢慢不再往上漫。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yǔ yù hé yòu kàn le yìhuí , děng zhǐ shàng de shù hé jiǎoxià de shuǐ duì dé shàng , cái shōugān .
pairs.english: Tavi and Yuhe checked again, waiting until the figures matched the water below before packing the rod.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维与郁禾又看了一回，等纸上的数和脚下的水对得上，才收杆。

pairs.target: huíchéng zài lùbiān mǎifàn , ruǎn héng wèn tā huán yuànbuyuàn gēn .
pairs.english: Buying food on the way back, Ruanheng asked if he still wanted to come.
pairs.hanzi: 回程在路边买饭，阮衡问他还愿不愿跟。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō yuànyì , què yòu wèn shìbushì wǎnghòu yě huì pèngdào shuí dōu bùkěn qīng de gōu .
pairs.english: Tavi said yes, then asked if they'd meet ditches nobody would clear.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说愿意，却又问是不是往后也会碰到谁都不肯清的沟。

pairs.target: " huì . "
pairs.english: “Yes.”

pairs.target: " nà nǐ yǒushí yě huì nòngcuò ? "
pairs.english: “And you sometimes make mistakes?”
pairs.hanzi: “那你有时也会弄错？”

pairs.target: " huì .
pairs.english: “Yes.

pairs.target: nǐ yào děng wǒ shuō yǒngyuǎn búhuì , fàn jiù liáng le . "
pairs.english: Wait for me to say never, and lunch will go cold.”
pairs.hanzi: 你要等我说永远不会，饭就凉了。”

pairs.target: yù hé duān zhe wǎn xiào le yìshēng .
pairs.english: Yuhe laughed over her bowl.
pairs.hanzi: 郁禾端着碗笑了一声。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiāng xuéxiào nà lián zhǐ cóng dài lǐ náchū , fàngzài gān chù , xiěxià tóngyì .
pairs.english: Tavi took his school slip from his bag and wrote his agreement somewhere dry.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维将学校那联纸从袋里拿出，放在干处，写下同意。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng yě qiān le , dìng hǎo bātiān hòu zhèngshì dào suǒ lǐ , shíliù zhōu àn yuē zǒu , tóu yìlún chū chéng suí nǎ yíduì , děng shíjì gōng dānpái hǎo zài gàozhī .
pairs.english: Ruanheng signed too: report to the office in eight days, sixteen weeks as agreed, first out-of-city crew to be named once actual work orders were scheduled.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡也签了，定好八天后正式到所里，十六周按约走，头一轮出城随哪一队，等实际工单排好再告知。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi de běnshì réng àn wéi lǎoshī jiāo lái de fànwéi yòng , chuánrè nà yíxiàng liúzài xuéxiào liàn .
pairs.english: Tavi's skills remained within Vey's specified scope, heat transfer for school practice only.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维的本事仍按维老师交来的范围用，传热那一项留在学校练。

pairs.target: xiàwǔ huí xuégōng , tā xiān qù gěi nài lěi liú le zhāng duǎn tiáo , shuō zìjǐ dìng le hé lù suǒ , gǎitiān xiǎng dāngmiàn jiǎng .
pairs.english: Back that afternoon, he left Nerai a note about choosing the Joint Routes Office and wanting to talk another day.
pairs.hanzi: 下午回学宫，他先去给奈蕾留了张短条，说自己定了合路所，改天想当面讲。

pairs.target: tā ménqián de xié yǐjīng huàn le yìshuāng , rén zài bu zài , tā méi yìng qiāo .
pairs.english: The shoes outside her door had changed; unsure she was in, he didn't insist on knocking.
pairs.hanzi: 她门前的鞋已经换了一双，人在不在，他没硬敲。

pairs.target: sùshè lǐ , pà wò wèn bàntiān xuéhuì shénme .
pairs.english: In the dormitory Pavo asked what he had learned in half a day.
pairs.hanzi: 宿舍里，帕沃问半天学会什么。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ zhānní de liáng gān kào zài ménbiān , shuō xiān xuéhuì bié wǎng rén lǐngkǒu diào tǔ .
pairs.english: Tavi rested the muddy measuring rod by the door: first learn not to drop dirt down someone's collar.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把沾泥的量杆靠在门边，说先学会别往人领口掉土。

pairs.target: pà wò kànkàn tā de jiān , méi rěnzhù .
pairs.english: Pavo looked at his shoulder and couldn't help laughing.
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃看看他的肩，没忍住。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zìjǐ yě xiào le , tuō xià wàiyī dǒu le liǎngxià , jǐlì xì ní luòdào dìshàng .
pairs.english: Tavi laughed too, shaking out his coat; specks of dirt fell to the floor.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维自己也笑了，脱下外衣抖了两下，几粒细泥落到地上。

pairs.target: tā qù ná sàozhou , zhè yícì , dài lǐ de zhǐ yǐjīng yǒu le liǎnggè rén de míngzì .
pairs.english: He went for a broom. This time the paper in his bag already bore two names.
pairs.hanzi: 他去拿扫帚，这一次，袋里的纸已经有了两个人的名字。
